title: ScooterAir kerbside exposure at a 90-s red light — ESTIMATE (推估), not a measurement
model: model.mjs (method of record: corrected source-dispersion Monte Carlo)
reproduce: node model.mjs --write  (estimate(call) with the recorded call reproduces each scenario exactly in Node/V8)

conventions.published: only CO, benzene and PM2.5 increments at 1.5 m, rounded to 1 significant figure, as ranges; particle number, height ratios and time series are recorded but NOT published

fuelFlow_gph.source: Nguyen et al. 2025 J Chin Inst Eng doi:10.1080/02533839.2025.2531199 (84-101 g/h, abstract); Nguyen et al. 2021 Int J Urban Sci doi:10.1080/12265934.2020.1871059 (180 g/h, abstract; its own carbon balance implies ~210 g/h); engine-physics 101-193 g/h

moenvCObins.unit: inspection tests per idle-CO bin (% CO)
moenvCObins.source: MOENV 各縣市機車排氣定檢CO檢測值統計表 114年 (2025), national row, n = 9,067,160 tests; https://mobile.moenv.gov.tw/Motor/ReportNew/Unit_CO_Report.aspx?YearMonth=2025/12 (opened by critic-inputs and gap-answers-c). Per test incl. retests; scooters >= 5 y old only

firstBinMean_pct.source: ASSUMPTION (bin holds 75 % of tests; no finer split published)

newShare.unit: share of idling kerb fleet < 5 y old (not inspected)
newShare.source: Phase 7 ~27 % of registered fleet (inputs-emission-rates.json); kerb fleet assumed newer

newCO_pct.unit: % CO at idle, new FI+catalyst scooter (then x0.5-1.5 per scooter)
newCO_pct.source: ASSUMPTION: no Taiwanese reading; below 2.0 % in-use limit for 2017+ build (MOENV gazette 2023-06-30)

newTHCscale.unit: THC multiplier for new scooters vs inspected fleet
newTHCscale.source: ASSUMPTION (critic-inputs: new scooters were given clean CO but old-fleet THC)

carbonSum_pct.source: Cheng et al. 2017 Bull Coll Eng NIU 12:33-76, Yilan inspection means CO+CO2 12.0-12.2 % (via inputs-emission-rates.json)

thcPerFuel.unit: g THC per g fuel, ordinary four-stroke (FID-equivalent)
thcPerFuel.source: NDIR inspection route 0.006-0.027 (under-reads aromatics); Yao et al. 2008 Atmos Environ 42:6560 bench idle FID 0.040-0.043 (V); Hanoi lab 0.057 (abstract)

hcHigh4sShare.unit: share of four-strokes that are HC high emitters
hcHigh4sShare.source: MOENV 2025 HC table: 12,280 HC failures in 8.29 M tests = 0.15 % (V, critic-inputs); up to 1 % allowed for uninspected/borderline (A)

hcHighPerFuel.unit: g THC per g fuel, HC high emitter / two-stroke
hcHighPerFuel.source: carbon balance on 5,431 ppm two-stroke (Taipei Times 2018, S) and failed-HC mean 5,823 ppm (MOENV 2025, V) at 3-6 ppmC per ppm hexane

benzeneFracTHC.unit: g benzene per g THC, four-stroke
benzeneFracTHC.source: Yao 2008 Table 1 idle benzene 764-918 mg/L vs THC 30-32 g/L = 2.5-3.0 % (V); Tsai et al. 2018 catalysed Taiwanese scooters ~2-3 % (chart reading, S); TEDS inventory 0.77 % (biased low: evaporative HC in denominator, S); Stockwell 2016 ACP 16:11043 one pre-service Nepali bike, BTEX-based (V, split assumed)

benzeneFrac2s.unit: g benzene per g THC, two-stroke
benzeneFrac2s.source: ASSUMPTION: scavenged fuel; Taiwan gasoline benzene cap 0.9 % v/v (~1 % m/m)

pnPerKgFuel.unit: solid particles > 23 nm per kg fuel
pnPerKgFuel.source: Kontses et al. 2020 Environ Res 182:109071 WMTC 2e11-3e12 /km (V) x 46.9 km/kg; idle factor ~15 each way (inputs-speciation-particles.json); Chien & Huang 2010 idle/30 km/h (abstract)

pnTotalFactor.unit: total / solid >23 nm (10-23 nm added; volatile nucleation NOT included)

twoStrokeShare.unit: share of idling scooters that are two-stroke
twoStrokeShare.source: ~280,000 of ~14 M registered (inputs-emission-rates.json); kerb share assumed

pmPerKgFuel.unit: g PM2.5 per kg fuel, ordinary scooter
pmPerKgFuel.source: ASSUMPTION centred between Euro 3 cycle 0.03-0.10 (Kontses 2020, derived) and Nepal serviced idle 0.71 (Jayarathne et al. 2018 ACP 18:2259, V). Ting 2023 tunnel 0.013 +- 0.143 g/kg NOT used (indistinguishable from zero)

pmSmokerPerKg.unit: g PM2.5 per kg fuel, smoker
pmSmokerPerKg.source: Jayarathne 2018: Nepal pre-service idle 8.81 +- 1.33 g/kg (V) as top

slotArea_m2.unit: m2 of stop box per scooter
slotArea_m2.source: Chang & Chang 2014 交通學報 14(1), reviewing 許添本 & 王義川 2001

boxDepth_m.source: 道路交通標誌標線號誌設置規則 art. 174-2

boxWidth_m.source: ASSUMPTION: no width in art. 174-2; lanes 3-4 m (IOT-113-TB006)

queueLaneWidth_m.unit: m width of overflow queue behind the box

offFrac.unit: share of queued engines switched off

presentAtOnset.unit: share of end-of-red queue already stopped at red onset

arrivalWindow_s.unit: s over which the rest arrive (uniform)

sourceHeight_m.source: IOT-113-TB006 sec 4.2.2 uses 0.5 m; 0.3-0.5 m scene file

receptorAlong_m.unit: fraction: pedestrian position from back of box (0) to 1 m past stop line (1)

windSpeed_ms.unit: m/s scalar speed at ~1.5 m, 90-s mean
windSpeed_ms.source: ASSUMPTION: 0.2-0.6 x CWA 1991-2020 station means (Taipei 2.6, Taichung 1.5, Kaohsiung 2.1 m/s, V); IOT on-site July 2024 0.4-3.6 m/s (V)

sv0.source: AERMOD minimum sigma_v 0.2 m/s; light-wind ~0.5 (EPA-454/B-26-003 sec 5, V)

sw0.unit: m/s floor on sigma_w (traffic, engine heat)

sy0.source: ASSUMPTION: scooter+rider size; no wake for idling queues (CAL3QHC, V)

bgCO_ppm.source: MOENV 2025 annual report Table 3-23: general stations 0.24, traffic stations 0.54 ppm; IOT nearby station hourly 0.03-0.90

bgBenzene_ppb.source: Re-sourced (C6). Taiwan HAP network national annual mean ~0.5 ppbv, urban > non-urban (NCKU thesis via search excerpt, S, needsManualFetch); Bangkok kerb 2-3 ppb (V via repo); Kaohsiung 2.8-4.8 ppb (S). Wide on purpose

bgPN_cm3.source: Cheung et al. 2013 ACP 13:8935 Taipei 13,900 (V); Abdillah 2024 roadside 25,000-38,000 (abstract)

bgPM25_ugm3.source: MOENV 2025 annual mean 13.4 (traffic 15.4); IOT kerb July 2024 4-14

scenarios.label: A few scooters (2-5)
scenarios.basis: IOT quiet junction 819 motorcycles/h (12-h hourly mean) -> ~3-10 per approach per red; nearest 2-4 m

timeSeriesCO.note: CO increment at top height; mean shape set by the assumed arrival law; ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY, not published as a curve

massBalanceBoxHeadline.status: upper bound only; IOT replica with corrected queue over-predicts 3-20x

empiricalRouteA.status: IOT low-cost sensors; only 1 of 4 sites resolves an increment
